text: dsh-session-delete 是面向 DSH Web 侧栏的会话管理插件：在会话菜单和悬停行按钮中加入删除入口，并通过确认弹窗提交操作。Host 端先归档会话，再删除持久化日志目录、解除工作区关联并通知客户端刷新。它会拒绝正在打开或运行中的会话，并在成功后显示提示。适合希望清理 DSH 会话记录的桌面用户；需要 DSH 桌面版，不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-session-delete adds session removal to the DSH sidebar. A menu item and hover button open a confirmation dialog. The host archives the session, deletes its stored log, and refreshes the client list. Active sessions are refused. No extra key or service is needed.
想把 DSH 侧栏里不再需要的会话和磁盘记录一起删掉。
DSH 有没有办法永久清理已经归档的对话？
我想从会话列表直接删除一条旧记录，而不是只把它藏起来。
能不能在删除会话前弹出确认，避免误点？
会话删完后，怎样让侧栏马上移除它？
I want to permanently remove an old DSH conversation and its saved log.
Can I delete a session from its sidebar row after confirming?
How can I clear archived sessions from the workspace list and storage?
从会话行菜单选择「删除会话…」即可打开确认界面；确认后删除该会话日志并更新列表。
Hover over a sidebar session row and click its trash button to open a confirmation dialog before deleting.
Host 先归档会话，再依据持久化后端提供的位置删除会话目录，并解除工作区关联。
Deletion is refused while a session is open or has active work; the dialog displays the returned reason.
On success, the host emits a removal event so the client drops the cached session and shows a notice.
dsh-session-delete 使用递归文件删除移除会话日志目录；此操作会永久清除磁盘记录，无法由插件恢复。
删除前会先归档会话；如果会话仍打开或有运行任务，插件会拒绝操作，需结束活动后再试。

@local/dsh-session-delete README · 功能特性：| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 两个入口 | 会话行悬停时的垃圾桶按钮；会话行菜单里的红色「删除会话…」项（排在「归档」之后） |
| 确认弹窗 | 明确提示「将永久删除「xxx」的完整对话记录（含磁盘日志），此操作不可恢复」，防止误触 |
| 安全围栏 | 先走官方归档流程；运行中的会话（live session）直接拒绝删除，防止撕裂日志产生残影；删除前校验目录形状（`<root>/<project>/<session-id>` 两级），只删目标会话自己的目录 |
| 精确定位 | 使用持久化层提供的 `locate()` 位置，绝不自行拼接路径 |
| 即时反馈 | 删除成功后 toast 提示「已删除会话「xxx」」，会话列表立即刷新 |

```powershell

cd dsh-session-delete
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```

<summary>方式二：手动挂载（点开查看）</summary>

@local/dsh-session-delete README · 卸载：```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 -Uninstall
```

重启 DSH 后生效；克隆下来的仓库文件不会被删除。

<details>
<summary>工作原理（点开查看）</summary>

- `host.js`（Node 侧）：归档 → 通过持久化层定位日志目录 → 校验目录形状 → 删除 → 从工作区脱离 → 发出 `api-session/removed` 事件让客户端刷新列表；所有安全围栏都在这一侧。
- `client.js`（浏览器侧）：向 `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`（行菜单）、`sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action`（悬停按钮）、`shell.overlay`（确认弹窗 + toast）三个扩展槽注入 UI，只负责发起请求与展示。

</details>

@local/dsh-session-delete README · dsh-session-delete：Deletion removes the session's complete record (including the on-disk log) and is irreversible — if you just want it out of sight, keep using the built-in "archive".

@local/dsh-session-delete README · Features：| Capability | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Two entries | A trash button on session-row hover; a red 「删除会话…」 item in the row menu (after "archive") |
| Confirm dialog | Explicitly warns 「将永久删除「xxx」的完整对话记录（含磁盘日志），此操作不可恢复」 to prevent accidents |
| Safety fences | Archives through the official flow first; live (running) sessions are refused outright to avoid torn logs; verifies the `<root>/<project>/<session-id>` two-level shape and deletes only the target session's own directory |
| Precise location | Uses the persistence layer's `locate()` — never a re-derived path |
| Instant feedback | A 「已删除会话」 toast on success; the session list refreshes immediately |

<details>
<summary>How it works (click to expand)</summary>

@local/dsh-session-delete README · Uninstall：- `host.js` (Node side): archive → locate the log directory via the persistence layer → verify the directory shape → delete → detach from the workspace → emit `api-session/removed` so the client refreshes the list. All safety fences live on this side.
- `client.js` (browser side): injects UI into three extension slots — `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` (row menu), `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` (hover button) and `shell.overlay` (confirm dialog + toast) — only requesting and displaying.
